commands.command:
set -e
EXPECTED_SHA="b83b716d02ae2a93879b4b1c4c8e5aa3f30403db"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_SHA"
export JAVA_HOME="$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21)"
APK="$(find app/build/outputs/apk/debug -name '*.apk' -type f | head -n1)"
if [ -z "$APK" ]; then
  ./gradlew --no-daemon :app:assembleDebug
  APK="$(find app/build/outputs/apk/debug -name '*.apk' -type f | head -n1)"
fi
test -n "$APK"
adb start-server >/dev/null
python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess,re,sys,time
def run(args,timeout=5):
    try: return subprocess.run(args,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=timeout)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: return None
def s22():
    p=run(["adb","devices"],3)
    if not p: return None
    for line in p.stdout.splitlines()[1:]:
        parts=line.split()
        if len(parts)>=2 and parts[1]=="device":
            serial=parts[0]
            q=run(["adb","-s",serial,"shell","getprop","ro.product.model"],3)
            if q and q.stdout.strip()=="SM-S906B": return serial
    return None
serial=s22()
if not serial:
    m=run(["adb","mdns","services"],6)
    eps=[]
    if m:
        for line in m.stdout.splitlines():
            if "_adb-tls-connect._tcp" in line:
                for token in reversed(line.split()):
                    if re.search(r":\d+$",token):
                        eps.append(token); break
    for ep in eps:
        run(["adb","connect",ep],4)
        time.sleep(.4)
        serial=s22()
        if serial: break
if not serial:
    for ep in [
        "Android-2.local:40503",
        "192.168.0.100:40503",
        "192.168.0.100:34771",
        "192.168.0.100:39687",
        "192.168.0.100:34745",
    ]:
        run(["adb","connect",ep],3)
        time.sleep(.3)
        serial=s22()
        if serial: break
if not serial:
    print("S22_ADB_UNREACHABLE")
    sys.exit(42)
open("/tmp/tracker-s22-serial","w").write(serial)
print("S22_ADB_CONNECTED model=SM-S906B")
PY
S="$(cat /tmp/tracker-s22-serial)"
OUT="$(adb -s "$S" install -r "$APK")"
printf '%s
' "$OUT"
test -n "$(adb -s "$S" shell pm path io.blueeye | tr -d '' | head -n1)"
adb -s "$S" shell monkey -p io.blueeye -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/dev/null
sleep 1
PID="$(adb -s "$S" shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '' | head -n1)"
test -n "$PID"
printf 'TRACKER_INSTALL_OK sha=%s model=SM-S906B data_mode=preserved package_present=yes app_running=yes pid=%s
' "$EXPECTED_SHA" "$PID"
